run_densepose_dump: run the DensePose model on input images and dump results to a pickle file
run_densepose_show: run the DensePose model on input images and visualize results with contour or segmentation overlays
run_densepose_texture_visualization: run the DensePose model and visualize IUV texture transfer results using a texture atlas file
run_densepose_vertex_visualization: run the DensePose model and visualize vertex-based outputs on input images
run_densepose_bounding_box: run the DensePose model and visualize scored bounding boxes on detected instances
